You can see a fridge. The fridge contains a raw pork chop, an orange bell pepper and a carrot. You can make out an opened oven nearby. What a letdown! The oven is empty! You can make out a table. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you make out a cookbook. You can make out a stove. But the thing is empty.



There is a knife, a diced roasted yellow bell pepper, a raw yellow potato and a raw purple potato on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a diced roasted red potato, a diced fried block of cheese and a sliced roasted red hot pepper.

thought: I should take the diced roasted yellow bell pepper from the floor so I have all prepared ingredients to prepare the meal.
action: take diced roasted yellow bell pepper from floor
feedback: You pick up the yellow bell pepper from the ground.
